entries.description: Every customer PHP version gets the OPcache isolation drop-in in its FPM conf.d: no customer script reads another's cached files or drives the shared cache. The drop-in is ours alone, so the copy is the state.

Web domains rendered again: apache binds every fcgi handler a .htaccess sets to the domain's own pool, and the pools lose /tmp. A PHP profile under /etc/hestia/templates takes the new one only while it is as 0.40 shipped it, an edited one is named.
